visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: When ordinary lives quietly fracture into disturbing private pursuits, can any genuine bond actually survive?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: In Todd Solondz's ensemble drama, several individuals cross paths as they pursue personal fulfillment through actions that defy social norms, fueled by a desperate search for human connection.
